meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 装上后,系统会多出一个 DeltaChat 频道:通过电子邮件收发端到端加密消息(IMAP/SMTP),支持私聊和群聊;收到消息后会自动创建聊天记录,并能设置 agent 来回复。
howto.when: 当你需要把 DeltaChat 接入系统时触发,例如要求添加该渠道、配置邮箱凭据或生成邀请链接。

say.text: 帮我添加 DeltaChat 渠道并完成配置。
say.note: 会执行安装步骤并检查依赖。

say.text: 配置 DeltaChat 的邮箱账号,设置 IMAP 和 SMTP。
say.note: 会在 .env 中写入所需凭据。

say.text: 生成 DeltaChat 邀请链接和二维码。
say.note: 会输出链接并保存二维码 SVG。

howto.what_en: After installation, the system gains a DeltaChat channel: it sends and receives end-to-end encrypted messages over email (IMAP/SMTP), supports DMs and group chats, auto-creates chat records on incoming messages, and can wire chats to an agent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a DeltaChat channel, configure email credentials for it, or generate an invite link.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel and finish setup.
say_en.note: Runs install steps and validates dependencies.

say_en.text: Configure DeltaChat email account, set IMAP and SMTP.
Generate a DeltaChat invite link and QR code.
say_en.note: Outputs URL and saves QR SVG.
